title: Cough (Dry & Productive / Tussis) — Dual-System Clinical Monograph
source: WHO Clinical Guidelines & Ayurvedic Pharmacopoeia of India
content:
Condition: Cough (Dry / Wet Tussis).
Allopathic Pharmacology: For Dry Cough: Dextromethorphan Hydrobromide 10-20mg (antitussive). For Wet/Productive Cough: Ambroxol 30mg or Guaifenesin 100mg (mucolytic expectorant). In allergic cough: Levocetirizine 5mg.
Ayurvedic Formulations: Sitopaladi Churna (3-5g with honey) for dry tickly cough. Kantakari Avaleha or Vasavaleha (5g twice daily) as potent bronchodilator and expectorant. Honitus or Koflet herbal syrups.
Home Remedies: Warm Honey with Ginger juice and crushed Black pepper (1 tsp 3 times daily), Salt water gargles (1/2 tsp salt in warm water, 3 times daily), Mulethi (Licorice) root chewing.
Safety: Honey should not be given to infants under 1 year. If cough lasts > 2 weeks or contains blood, consult doctor immediately.
